document.name: Bronx H.Y.P.E — Family Fridays
document.description:
Bronx H.Y.P.E (Helping Y(our) People Evolve) is a Family Enrichment Center at 109 Bruckner Boulevard in the Bronx that describes itself as a family-centered, community-driven, homelike space in Mott Haven. The official site says the center is open to children, youth, and adults of all ages and holds multiple offerings throughout the year to help neighbors get involved, have fun, and support the community.

Its official Family Friday page describes a recurring Friday meetup from 4:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. at 111 Bruckner Blvd, Suite 203, where families can enjoy games and arts and crafts together. The page says children are welcome with adult supervision, and lists community liaison Julian at Julian@theremcenter.org / 646-801-0191 for questions.

Sources: https://bronxhype.org/ https://bronxhype.org/about/ https://bronxhype.org/event/family-game-nights/2026-04-03/ https://www.nyc.gov/site/acs/about/fec.page
